info.title: ADMITRA API
info.summary: Multi-tenant online admission platform with merit prediction and marks verification.
info.description: REST API of ADMITRA. Every response uses the envelope `{ success, data, meta }`; errors use `{ success: false, error: { code, message, details } }`. Send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Lists are paginated with `page` and `limit` (default 20, maximum 100, PERF-2). This document is generated from the mounted routers (`npm run docs:api`).
